title: Brand Heritage Timeline
desc: Interactive chronological timeline mapping historical brand milestones from 1928 founding to present day global expansion.
heading: A Century of Craftsmanship
subtitle: Trace our journey across ten decades of textile innovation and atelier mastery.

milestones.title: The Florentine Guild
milestones.description: First weaving loom established in San Frediano, producing bespoke virgin wool for local tailoring houses.

milestones.title: Introduction of Cashmere
milestones.description: Pioneered ethically sourced Mongolian cashmere spinning in Northern Italy.

milestones.title: Global Flagships
milestones.description: Expanded to Paris, Tokyo, and New York while maintaining artisanal small-batch production.

milestones.title: Zero-Carbon Atelier
milestones.description: Achieved 100% Gold Standard climate neutrality across all workshops and logistics.
